第13章：世界上最好的报复别人的方法
言安希只是愣了一下，然后很快就反应过来了，不管三七二十一，先叫再说。
她悄悄的抿了一下红唇：“老公……”
慕迟曜很是受用，刚才皱起的眉头，现在也都舒展开了：“真听话。”
言安希见他这么高兴，心里一动，想起今天上午在民政局被他扣掉的一千块钱，顿时来了精神。
她也不管现在是在哪里了，钱比较重要。对她来说，钱其实不是钱，而是她弟弟的命。
“对啊对啊，我很听话的。”言安希说，“那你能不能……把上午扣掉的那一千块，还给我？”
慕迟曜侧头看着她，眼睛里荡起点点笑意：“脑袋还是转得很快的，嗯？”
“不然呢？”言安希反问，“你觉得，我是来体验生活？”
第二杯热气腾腾的咖啡也再次端了上来，言安希看了一眼，然后看向慕迟曜：“这是要……干什么？”
他刚刚点了，可是又说他不喝，她现在也不想喝，那点了这杯咖啡拿上来干什么？
慕迟曜的声音很平稳，带着一点慵懒：“她刚才怎么倒在你身上的，现在就怎么倒回去。”
他的声音就好像是在说今天的天气一样平常。
“有什么不好？世界上最好的报复别人的方法，就是以其人之道，还治其人之身。”
他和她在说话，李韵是听到了的，现在已经吓得目光呆滞了。
这么烫的咖啡，要是倒在她身上，那真的是要脱一层皮了。
言安希在犹豫，迟迟不肯伸出手去。
慕迟曜看出了她的犹豫，淡淡的说道：“没事，可以等，我有的是时间，慢慢耗。”
言安希听出了他这句话里的言外之意。
她哪里敢耗他的时间啊，今天上午登记结婚，程序一完成他就走了，陈航说的那语气，好像是耽误了多不得了的事情一样。
言安希狠狠心，咬咬牙，跺跺脚，慢慢的伸出手去，拿起了那杯咖啡。
慕迟曜支着额角，淡淡的看着她，眼里的神色晦暗不明。
言安希握着杯子就觉得烫手，她迟疑了一下，回头看了慕迟曜一眼。
而李韵，已经腿软得直接跪在地上了。看来今天，她是难逃这一次了。
言安希慢慢的站了起来，朝李韵走了过去，她走得很慢，每一步都像是无比艰难一样。
就算走得再慢，她还是走到李韵面前了。
“你……”言安希端着咖啡，看着李韵，还是下不去这个手。
这种事情，她真的做不来啊，她虽然讨厌李韵，但是也从来没有想过要这样欺负她。
言安希能感觉到慕迟曜的目光一直落在她身上，让她后背僵直，浑身都不自在了。
她想了想，还是退缩了：“慕迟曜……”
慕迟曜却适时的回应了她：“言安希，动手吧。”
李韵跌坐在地上，往后缩了缩，神情十分的慌张：“这……安希，你不能这样。我，我认错，也道歉，你看在我们是同学的份上……”

Chapter 13: The best way in the world to get revenge on others
Yan Anxi was just stunned for a moment, and then quickly realized, no matter what, call first and then talk.
She pursed her red lips quietly: "Husband..."
Mu Chi Yao was very pleased. The frown he had just frowned now relaxed: "You are so obedient."
Seeing him so happy, Yan Anxi's heart moved, and she suddenly became energetic when she remembered the thousand yuan that was deducted from him at the Civil Affairs Bureau this morning.
She doesn't care where she is now, money is more important. For her, money is not actually money, but her brother's life.
"Yes, yes, I am very obedient." Yan Anxi said, "Then can you... give me back the one thousand yuan deducted this morning?"
Mu Chi Yao looked sideways at her, with a little smile in his eyes: "My head still turns very fast, huh?"
"Otherwise?" Yan Anxi asked, "Do you think I'm here to experience life?"
The second cup of steaming coffee was brought again. Yan Anxi glanced at it, then looked at Mu Chi Yao: "What are you doing...?"
He just ordered it, but he said he didn't want to drink it, and she didn't want to drink it now. So why did she bring this cup of coffee after she ordered it?
Mu Chi Yao's voice was very steady, with a bit of laziness: "She fell on you just now, why should she fall back now."
His voice sounded as normal as if he were talking about today's weather.
"What's wrong? The best way in the world to retaliate against others is to treat others the same way they are treated."
He was talking to her, and Li Yun heard it, and now her eyes were dull with fear.
If such hot coffee were poured on her, it would really peel off a layer of her skin.
Yan Anxi hesitated and refused to reach out.
Mu Chi Yao noticed her hesitation and said calmly: "It's okay, you can wait. I have plenty of time, so I'll use it up slowly."
Yan Anxi heard the implication of his words.
How dare she waste his time? She registered her marriage this morning, and he left as soon as the procedure was completed. Chen Hang's tone of voice sounded like he had delayed a lot of things.
Yan Anxi gritted her teeth, stamped her feet, slowly reached out and picked up the cup of coffee.
Mu Chi Yao propped up his forehead and looked at her lightly, with a dark look in his eyes.
Yan Anxi felt her hands were hot as she held the cup. She hesitated and looked back at Mu Chi Yao.
As for Li Yun, her legs were so weak that she knelt on the ground. It seems that today, she will not be able to escape this time.
Yan Anxi stood up slowly and walked towards Li Yun. She walked very slowly, and every step seemed extremely difficult.
No matter how slowly she walked, she still walked in front of Li Yun.
"You..." Yan Anxi held the coffee and looked at Li Yun, but still couldn't let go.
She really couldn't do this kind of thing. Although she hated Li Yun, she had never thought of bullying her like this.
Yan Anxi could feel Mu Chi Yao's eyes always falling on her, making her back stiffen and her whole body feel uncomfortable.
She thought for a while, but still flinched: "Mu Chi Yao..."
Mu Chi Yao responded to her in time: "Yan Anxi, let's do it."
Li Yun fell to the ground, shrank back, and looked very panicked: "This... An Xi, you can't do this. I, I admit my mistake and apologize. For the sake of us being classmates..."
